en: Black‑and‑white view of a European old-town street and square with brick and stone townhouses, shops at street level, and people walking on a cobbled plaza. The central building has a large arched window and ornate gable with the inscription in German script above the window. Shopfront signs in German are visible on the ground floor. In the background rise the tall spire of a Gothic cathedral and, to the right, a large medieval castle tower set on a hill.
